candidate_content_fingerprint.scope: All 111 post-V1 candidate paths except this self-describing validation receipt.
candidate_content_fingerprint.algorithm: Sort Git path strings ordinally; for each path normalize valid UTF-8 CRLF and lone CR to LF while preserving invalid-UTF-8 bytes, then emit lowercase SHA-256, TAB, forward-slash-normalized path, and LF; SHA-256 the UTF-8 concatenation including the final LF.
